group.description: The group for the maven project

artifact.description: The artifact for the maven project

version.description: The version for the maven project

partial.description: Flag to generate all the components or only the models/controllers related

entities.description: Array with the schema of the entities

controllers.description: Array with the schema of the controllers

name.description: Name of the column in the database

primary_key.description: Flag used to indicate if the column is the primary key

autogenerated.description: Flag used to indicate if the column is autogenerated

sequence.description: Name of the sequence used to generate the value, only used if provided and is a primary key autogenerated

unique.description: Flag used to indicate if the column is unique

reference_column.description: Name of the column that this column references, only required when the attribute is a Entity with ComposedID

attribute-relation.description: Data about the relation of this attribute with other Entity

related_entity.description: Name of the other Entity related with the attribute

intermediate_table.description: Name of the intermediate table in database, only required when define many to many relations

owner.description: Flag used to indicate what part of the relation is the owner (who can update the data)

columns.description: Data about the columns in the intermediate table that are related with this Entity table

reverse_columns.description: Data about the columns in the intermediate table that are related with the other Entity table

name.description: Name of the field in the json

validations.description: List of validations of the attribute

attributes.description: List of attributes of the attribute

type.description: Type of the attribute, values accepted are the OpenAPI types

format.description: Format of the attribute, values accepted are the OpenAPI formats for the given type

is_collection.description: Flag used to indicate if the parameter is a collection

related_entity.description: Name of the entity that represents that attribute

entity_field_name.description: Name of the entity field that represents that attribute, if not given, by default uses the name transformed to snakeCase

entity.description: Name of the entity to with this controler belongs, if not provided asumes that is a nonentity controller

integer_value_one.description: Max number of digits in integer part

integer_value_two.description: Max number of digits in decimal part

method.description: The http method of the endpoint

name.description: Name of the method that implements the controller

related_entity.description: Entity related with this endpoint, if not provided asumes that is a nonentity endpoint

table.description: Name of the table in the databasem, if it's not defined, then the name of the entity transformed to kebab_case

name.description: Name of the attribute in Java

type.description: Type of the attribute in Java, can be a basic type (String, Boolean, Double, Float, Integer, Long, LocalDate, OffsetDateTime) a ComposedID or an Entity name

columns.description: Data about the columns related with this attribute that are in the entity table, if not provided the name of the column is the name of the property transformed to kebab_case

foreign_columns.description: Data about the columns related with this attribute that are in other entity table

validations.description: Validations to apply to the attribute

attributes.description: Attributes of the attribute, only used when the attribute type is ComposedID

is_collection.description: Flag used to indicate if the attribute is a collection or a object

required.description: Flag used to indicate if the parameter is required

in.description: Type of the parameter location, in the path of the mapping or in the query parameters

default_value.description: Default value of the parameter, accepts any type

validations.description: List of validations of the request

type.description: Type of the parameter, values accepted are the OpenAPI types

format.description: Format of the parameter, values accepted are the OpenAPI formats for the given type

is_collection.description: Flag used to indicate if the parameter is a collection

related_entity.description: Entity related with this request, if not provided asumes that is a nonentity request

attributes.description: List of attributes of the request

is_standard.description: Flag used to indicate if is a standard response

is_collection.description: Flag used to indicate if is a collection response

collection_name.description: Name of the collection in the standard response, only required when is collection and standard

related_entity.description: Entity related with this response, if not provided asumes that is a nonentity response

attributes.description: List of attributes of the response

default_status_code.description: Status code of the response, only if it is not standard entity out resource
